steps: Open the official study page at https://trialmed.com/studies/3151603-aus-ptb/
Confirm eligibility: healthy adult, 18-55 years old, able to stay overnight in Austin TX
Register your interest via the study page form
Complete pre-qualification: Trialmed reviews your medical history
Attend in-person screening (labs, physical exam) and ask questions before consenting
If qualified, enroll and complete the assigned 24-overnight stay group (Group 2A: 10/5-10/29 or Group 2AA: 10/19-11/12, 2026)
timing: 24 overnight stays at the Austin clinic (Group 2A: Mon 10/5-Thu 10/29, 2026 or Group 2AA: Mon 10/19-Thu 11/12, 2026); 0 outpatient visits, 0 calls; plus pre-study screening visit.
